latestVersion.changelog:
youtube-editor-online 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Launch your YouTube video editing and export workflow entirely online with AI-powered cloud processing.
- Upload video clips and describe your edits in plain language—no timeline or export settings required.
- Automatic setup with secure token authentication and cloud session management.
- Supports quick export to 1080p MP4, timeline editing, overlays, transitions, and more in 1–2 minutes.
- Handles error cases and provides feedback for smooth user experience.
- Accepts all common video, image, and audio formats up to 500MB per file.
